reporting-org.narrative: The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria

title.narrative: Investment for impact against Tuberculosis and HIV in the Democratic Republic of the Congo - Congo (Democratic Republic) (01-Jan-2018-31-Dec-2020)

description.narrative: Congo (Democratic Republic), TB/HIV, Stichting Cordaid (CORDAID)This program has the following goals: Contribuer au développement de la RDC par la réduction de la propagation du VIH/SIDA et la réduction de ses conséquences sur la population. Assurer la prise en charge globale de tous les patients co infectés TB/VIH en RD Congo. Réduire de 20% la mortalité liée à la tuberculose à l’horizon 2020 par rapport à celle estimée pour l’année 2015 (de 66 à 53 décès pour 100.000 hbts). The objectives of this program are: Réduire de 80% la proportion de nouvelles infections dans la population générale et les groupes cibles prioritaires. Réduire de 7.3% à 1.6% les décès liés au VIH parmi les personnes vivant avec le VIH. Réduire les nouvelles infections chez les nourrissons du VIH à 50 pour au moins 100.000 naissances vivantes. Réduire de moitié l’incidence du VIH et la mortalité liée au VIH dans la population des jeunes de 10 à 19 ans vivant dans un environnement favorable. Tester pour le VIH 90% malades tuberculeux enregistrés d'ici 2020 dans le pays. Mettre sous TARV 95% des cas TB/VIH identifiés. Réduire l’impact des violations des droits humains liés au VIH sur les PVVIH et les PA, les populations clés et les femmes ainsi que sur les jeunes et adolescents. Dépister d’ici 2020, un total cumulé de 498415 cas de TB toutes formes. Atteindre, d’ici 2020, un taux de succès thérapeutique supérieur à 90% pour tous les malades tuberculeux mis sous traitement. Augmenter le dépistage des cas de Tuberculose à bacilles pharmaco-résistants à 31% en 2020. Traiter avec avec succès 85% des cas TB-MR mis sous traitement d'ici 2020

title.narrative: Outcome indicators targets and results for COD-C-CORDAIDP01
Treatment success rate of all forms of TB - bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, new and relapse
Case notification rate of all forms of TB per 100,000 population - bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, new and relapse cases

TB O-5 (M): TB treatment coverage: Percentage of new and relapse cases that were notified and treated among the estimated number of incident TB cases in the same Year (all forms of TB - bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed)
Treatment success rate of RR-TB and/or MDR-TB: Percentage of patients with RR and/or MDR-TB successfully treated
Notification of RR-TB and/or MDR-TB cases – Percentage of notified cases of bacteriologically confirmed, drug resistant RR-TB and/or MDR-TB as a proportion of all estimated RR-TB and/or MDR-TB cases
Percentage of adults and children with HIV, known to be on treatment 12 months after initiation of antiretroviral therapy
Percent of respondents who say they used a condom the last time they had sex with a non-marital, non-cohabiting partner, of those who have had sex with such a partner in the last 12 months
Percentage of sex workers reporting using a condom with their most recent client
Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for COD-C-CORDAIDP01
TCP other-2: Number and percentage of health facilities (CSDT) who report no stock-out for TB sensitive drugs
GP other-2: Number of new cases SVS having received PEP within 72 hours

Number and percentage of new TB cases (all forms) successfully treated (cured plus completed treatment) who received support for treatment adherence from community health workers or community volunteers among all new TB cases (all forms) provided with treatment adherence support by community health workers or community volunteers
Percentage of sex workers that have received an HIV test during the reporting period and know their results
Percentage of men who have sex with men reached with HIV prevention programs - defined package of services
Percentage of men who have sex with men that have received an HIV test during the reporting period and know their results
Percentage of sex workers reached with HIV prevention programs - defined package of services
Number of notified TB cases (all forms) contributed by non-national TB program providers - community referrals
GP other-1: Number of new cases of sexual violence survivors (SVS)
TCS other-1: Number and percentage of Testing and Treatment sites reporting stock out of HIV tests
Percentage of people who inject drugs that have received an HIV test during the reporting period and know their results
Percentage of people who inject drugs reached with HIV prevention programs - defined package of services
Percentage of ART sites that had a stock-out of any antiretroviral drugs during the reporting period
Impact indicators targets and results for COD-C-CORDAIDP01
TB/HIV mortality rate per 100,000 population
Number of AIDS-related deaths per 100,000 population
TB incidence rate per 100,000 population
TB mortality rate per 100,000 population
Percentage of people living with HIV
RR-TB and/or MDR-TB prevalence among new TB patients: Proportion of new TB patients with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB
Estimated percentage of children newly infected with HIV from mother-to-child transmission among women living with HIV delivering in the past 12 months
Percentage of sex workers who are living with HIV
